results.content: # Male Fertility and the Microbiome: How Gut and Semen Bacteria Affect Sperm Health. Although additional human trials must be conducted before causation can be established, inflammation, oxidative stress, and endocrine modulation are known mechanisms that negatively impact sperm quality and the success of ARTs. In the future, the integration of multi-omics approaches that combine metagenomics, transcriptomics, and metabolomics data will provide a more functional understanding of the impact of the microbiome on male fertility.1,7 The development of next-generation probiotics, prebiotics, and other microbiome-targeted therapies, combined with the surge in machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) models, may also provide important insights needed to develop more effective interventions for male infertility.7,11.
